tasks-for-the-validity-upper-bound.text: Tasks for the validity upper bound.
Issue 334. Grouped by slice of the plan. A task is checked only after the ticket owner accepts its slice.

slice-every-builder-sets-its-window.text: Slice: every builder sets its window.
[ ] failing-checks-first: checks that fail on the base for the update, the termination booking and the creation (no upper bound), and for the dead staged bundle that blocks its wallet.
[ ] builders-census: every transaction builder the commands reach, with its bound or the reason it has none.
[ ] builders-set-the-bound: the update, the termination booking and the creation carry the bound.
[ ] recovery-controls-follow: the recovery controls extended to a booking and an update; the dead staged bundle releases its wallet.
[ ] costs-and-goldens-regenerated: creation cost receipts and goldens regenerated by the repository's tools.
[ ] pages-follow: the residual and the way-out limit removed with their controls.
[ ] hosted-forms-pass: lint, unit suites, documentation under the runner's bare path, the creation cost check and the hosted recovery partitions.
